description:
REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI)

Custom Orthotic Insoles   Blanks, Cork Components, Plastazote/Poron Materials, and Toppings
Tomah VA Medical Center (Tomah VAMC)
NAICS: 339113   Surgical Appliance and Supplies Manufacturing
PSC: 6515   Medical and Surgical Instruments, Equipment and Supplies


1. PURPOSE

The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Tomah VA Medical Center, located at 500 E. Veterans Street, Tomah, WI 54660 is conducting market research to identify qualified vendors capable of supplying orthotic blanks, cork components, Plastazote/Poron laminates, top-cover materials, and die cut insole components required for the fabrication of custom-fit insoles. This RFI is issued solely for information and planning purposes and does not constitute a solicitation.

The VA seeks information from all capable sources, including VOSB/SDVOSB, Small Business, and other business classifications. Vendors currently holding VA FSS 65 II A or GSA MAS contracts are strongly encouraged to respond.


2. REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION

Tomah VAMC requires the following items to replenish inventory used in the fabrication of custom orthotic shoe inserts. Vendors must indicate their ability to supply all or part of the items listed.

Required Items and Quantities

Plastazote / Poron Laminates & Toppings
PLASTIZOTE PORON TOP COVER SHEET   25
PLASTAZOTE PINK TOP COVER SHEET   6
BLACK X-STATIC TOP COVER SHEET   260

3. REQUESTED INFORMATION FROM VENDORS

Vendors responding to this RFI are requested to provide the following:

A. Company Information
Business name, address, UEI, point of contact
Business size and socioeconomic classification (e.g., SDVOSB, VOSB, SB, WOSB, etc.)
Confirmation of registration in SAM.gov

B. Contract Vehicle Availability
Indicate whether items are available on: 
VA Federal Supply Schedule (FSS 65 II A)
GSA Multiple Award Schedule (MAS)
Other government contract vehicles
Provide contract number(s) if applicable.

C. Technical Capability
Ability to supply each of the required items
Manufacturer information (if different from vendor) and country of origin
Product sheets or equivalent documentation for blanks, cork, Plastazote/Poron, and toppings
Lead times and shipping details

D. Pricing Information (Not binding)
Market pricing or schedule pricing (if on FSS/GSA)
Volume or bulk discount structures

E. Additional Information
Any suggested alternative items meeting equivalent specifications
Minimum order quantities (if any)


4. SUBMISSION INFORMATION
Responses should be submitted electronically via email to Stacy.Massey@va.gov 

Subject Line: RFI Response   Custom Fit Insoles Materials   Tomah VAMC

Response Due Date: May 13, 2026


5. DISCLAIMER

This RFI is issued solely for market research and planning. It does not obligate the Government to issue a solicitation or award a contract, nor does it commit the Government to any future action. No reimbursement will be provided for participation in this RFI.
